description: The environment manifest, preflight and session identity (engine-env, U4, D-069 items 3 and 12): the timeouts and id range of their subprocess and account calls.

env.gate_preflight_budget_s.description: How long the gate preflight (scripts/lib/preflight.py gate, before the gate lock, slot and worktree) may take on a machine with a gap, from the start of scripts/gate-local to its exit 2 (GX-01 acceptance: within seconds); gate-local.test.sh holds the real driver to it.

env.gate_preflight_probes.description: The probes of the gate preflight (scripts/lib/preflight.py gate), in order: the local test PostgreSQL (started when its binary matches, like setup) and the pinned toolchain. The engine launches no browser, so no system library is probed (VAZÃO F54, D-292). Credentials and GitHub REST are not probed: the gate itself needs none of them before it runs (GX-01, D-070).

env.tool_version_probe_timeout_s.description: How long a pinned tool may take to print its version banner during preflight and install checks.
